purpose: Reconsolidate the Weil, DPA/CA4, LTRAD, literature, and hostile-audit results; extract higher abstractions only when they yield exact invariants, no-go tests, or smaller research targets.

claim_boundary.new_scope: Structural synthesis and derived adapter/no-go lemmas; no analytic cancellation theorem is presumed.

architectures_kept_separate: QP/Turan DPA plus LTRAD fixed-strip route
CA4 as one sufficient DPA high-tail input
abstraction_tests: Does the abstraction identify a field forgotten by an invalid adapter?
Does it define a conserved quantity, dual obstruction, or composable loss budget?
Does it produce a theorem with a strictly smaller passport than the parent target?
Does a licensed countermodel falsify the abstract implication?
Can every categorical word be translated back into an explicit map or inequality?

candidate_structures.passport_category: Objects are arithmetic observables with source, mask, coefficient cone, normalization, quantifiers, resolution, kernel, rate, and output socket; morphisms are proved adapters annotated by losses.
candidate_structures.provenance_fibration: A forgetful map sends fully structured arithmetic objects to soft summaries. Countermodels test whether the desired property descends along its fibers.
candidate_structures.chain_complex: The zero-mass difference between adjacent-gap/Voronoi and natural prime measures is an exact zero-chain delta=D^*c; its symmetric-square lift is a product-graph divergence.
candidate_structures.local_global_descent: Restriction of the actual zeta kernel to a finite support window has many abstract positive extensions; cross-block arithmetic data is the missing descent datum.
candidate_structures.source_conditioned_dynamics: LTRAD is a fibered finite-time reachability problem in which the source event chooses the coefficient/target fiber before the height is selected.

success: A consolidated report with exact diagrams, generalized lemmas, falsifiers, a corrected decision tree, and ranked next experiments whose downstream sockets are explicit.
failure: If an abstraction merely renames CA4, LTRAD, global Weil positivity, or RH, label it as such and do not promote it.
verification: Check all exact algebra symbolically or with finite scripts where useful; validate the report against the current ledgers and preserve theorem-status labels.

post_run_outcome.exact_CA4_sharpening: The symmetric-square discrepancy collapses to one bounded s-balanced color and two matrix channels: (delta tensor s+s tensor delta)/2, with Fourier factor M_delta M_s.
post_run_outcome.analytic_result: No new analytic CA4, DPA, LTRAD, strip, global Weil positivity, or RH bound was proved.
